# Di

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

Di is a very pretty young girl who features black eyes, black hair, and rosy cheeks. Her appearance is characterized by a bright, lively look with notable snap and color, alongside a merry facial expression.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043)_

## Personality

Di is characterized as a good and smart individual. Her intellect and moral goodness are noted as her defining strengths, valued above mere physical beauty.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040)_

## History

Di, also known as Diana Barry, met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) in the garden at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), where the two quickly hit it off and solemnly vowed to be best friends forever. Later, Di hosted a party at her house where a dare led to [Anne](../character/anne.md) falling off her father's roof and breaking her ankle. When an advanced class was formed under Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) to prepare students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination, Di did not join, leaving [Anne](../character/anne.md) to miss her company while studying alongside their other peers.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P1](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P2](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P3](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P4](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P7](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), +57 more_

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--di.md)

Di and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) are close friends and chums who first met in the garden at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), where they solemnly vowed to be best friends forever. Their close bond involves spending time together socially, such as when Di hosted a party at her house where [Anne](../character/anne.md) suffered a broken ankle. Although they remain devoted companions, a dynamic of distance emerges when [Anne](../character/anne.md) joins an advanced preparation class for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination, leaving Di behind as she does not take the exam.

- Friend of — close friends and chums  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>
